notes.note: Discovery now scans the default Codex home plus configured homes (connection configHome, legacy app home, credential-profile homes), dedupes native ids to the earliest home, and resolves affinity for any home the latest discovery listed; STATION_EXTERNAL_CODEX_SOURCE_ROOT stays exclusive. getting-started, session-api, env-vars and connections describe this; other citing documents make no claim about which Codex homes are read.
